name: 1natsu
description: Personal collection of agent skills for coding agents, grouped into installable plugins.

plugins.name: 1natsu-commit
plugins.description: Git commit best practices with Conventional Commits.

plugins.name: 1natsu-pr
plugins.description: GitHub PR creation and autonomous review comment handling.

plugins.name: 1natsu-conflicts
plugins.description: Git conflict resolution, either fully autonomous or paired with a human.

plugins.name: 1natsu-document-harness
plugins.description: Harness documentation generation and audit with consistent placement and granularity.

plugins.name: 1natsu-debug
plugins.description: Collaborative debugging with human-in-the-loop observation, plus git repository analysis.

plugins.name: 1natsu-hunk
plugins.description: (experimental) Connects the agent to a live Hunk review session for human-in-the-loop local diff review.
